sourceBindings.text: One acre is a site question, not a feddan
A farmer has one acre with tight rows and asks for hand or machine weeding.
Convert one acre to about 4,047 m² or 0.964 Egyptian feddan; do not use 4–6 hours as a conversion.
Measure row clearance/stone risk and compare actual labour, time, machine fit and safety.
If actual fuel use and job-time data are missing, leave operating cost blank pending measurement.
Conditional choice with dimensions and missing data, not an automatic machine recommendation.

sourceBindings.text: Quote a service only from valid inputs
A learner proposes a weeding service for neighbouring small plots.
List actual total working area and suitable rows, setup/travel time, labour and maintenance.
Distinguish manufacturer 2.4 L capacity from measured L/hour and source 2.3 L/hour not verified for SER.
Request local fuel and labour prices and reserve for breakdown, safety and transport before a price or margin.
A transparent calculation template; no invented cost or guaranteed profit.
